quote: A really fun experience. It captures about 60% of what it feels like to be Agent 007. A solid 8/10.

author: MECvTime
quote: Good, a game you could beat with your eyes closed. Ridiculously easy and brain-dead, barely requiring any skill or effort. Just another mediocre, cutscene-heavy game that feels more like watching a movie than actually playing one. I couldn't get immersed in it at all.

author: MECvTime
quote: Rockstar's No. 1 masterpiece. A true work of art in gaming! The greatest open-world game of all time. Nothing else comes close to transporting you back to the Wild West and letting you truly experience the life of a cowboy. Unparalleled storytelling, with incredibly detailed and deeply nuanced character development. This masterpiece is for everyone willing to slow down, immerse themselves in its world, and appreciate every moment of this god-tier experience. Thank you, Rockstar.

author: MECvTime
quote: Even though it's just a graphical upgrade, I can only imagine how mind-blowing this game must have been back when the original first came out. Kojima, what an enigmatic genius.
